notes.title: Version 4.0.0 is here! Exiting Early Access
notes.content:
4.0.0 is now available, and we're officially out of Early Access!

So what does that mean?
- All of the major features that I originally intended for this program are complete. Most of my updates going forward will be bug fixes and QoL.
- Suggestions, feedback and bug reports are still welcome. 

[b]The following features have been added:[/b]
- Added a right click menu, with the following options
   - **Edit**: That's right, you can now change all information on a creature card that has already been created.
   - **Duplicate selected**: This will duplicate all cards you currently have selected.
   - **Delete selected**: This will delete all cards you currently have selected. The delete button has been removed from the face of cards to help prevent accidental deletions.
- Editing and Deleting have been added to the history log, meaning that they can both be un-done. Accidentally deleted your Big Bad Evil Guy? No longer an issue.

[b]Miscellaneous Quality Updates:[/b]
- Updated card dragging functionality so that if you have more than 1 creature card selected, all of them will move instead of just the one you click on.
- The instructions page in the main menu has been given a face lift. Lots of new features have been added since it was originally made, making it extremely outdated.

Thank you everyone who participated during Early Access, you are much appreciated :heart:

notes.title: Version 3.0.0
notes.content:
[b]The following feature has been added:[/b]
[list]
[*] All new Card Presets! This gives you the ability to save data out of, and load data into the card generator. You'll find the new buttons next to the card generator.
        [*] I am also providing all of the card presets for the standard Monster Manual, you can find the zip file to download in the [url=https://discord.gg/ethUNRYdcd]Discord[/url] Server.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous Quality Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Open Save Folder" button in the escape menu has been updated to show both Saved Encounters and Saved Card Presets.
[*] Fixed an issue where Canvas Anchors wouldn't be centered on various resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where generated creature cards wouldn't be created in the middle of the screen on various resolutions.
[*] With the following few changes, cards can now be modified and generated entirely from the keyboard using tab (Excluding customized color).
[*] You can now use the up and down arrows on your keyboard to modify the hit points dice.
[*] You can now generate a card using the "Enter" key if the Generate button is highlighted.
[/list]

As always, all feedback and bug reports are welcome!

notes.title: Version 2.0.4
notes.content:
2.0.4 is now available!

**The following updates have been made:**
- Canvas anchors! You can now set anchors around your encounter canvas, allowing you to quickly navigate between custom positions! Simply align your canvas, click on an anchor in the bottom right, and any time you click that anchor again you'll be returned to your saved position. These anchors are also saved when saving an encounter.
- You can now click on a history log entry, and your canvas will center itself on that creature. This will be particularly useful for multiple creatures with the same name.

**Miscellaneous Quality Updates:**
- Fixed some typos in the condition history log entries.
- Added a new setting to zoom in when clicking on a history log entry.

notes.title: Version 2.0.3
notes.content:
2.0.3 is now available!

[b]The following updates have been made:[/b]
- Both adding and removing conditions are now tracked in the history log! This includes the ability to undo conditions interactions.

[b]Miscellaneous Quality Updates:[/b]
- There is now a button in the escape menu to open the save file location. This should make it a lot easier to share encounters with others, and load encounters from others.

notes.title: Version 2.0.2
notes.content:
Table Top Creature Tracker has been updated to version 2.0.2!

[b]The following updates have been made:[/b]
[list]
[*] A history log has been added in the bottom left of the encounter canvas. Currently it only keeps track of health modifications on creature cards, expect more functionality to be added to this in the future.
[*]Additionally, you now have the ability to undo actions! "Oh shoot, that creature wasn't actually over there." is no longer an issue! Currently the undo buttons act as a "Reset the state of the encounter to when this happened" interaction.
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous Quality Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Encounter Canvas can now be moved by left, middle, and right click-drag instead of just left click-drag. This is in preparation for future functionality and customizability.
[/list]

If you have any questions, feedback or want to connect with other DM's, join the [url=https://discord.gg/ethUNRYdcd]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Version 2.0.1
notes.content:
Table Top Creature Tracker has been updated to version 2.0.1!

[b]The following updates have been made:[/b]
[list]
[*] Saving and loading encounters is now done through your systems file explorer! This will allow you to load encounters from anywhere on your device. This also allows you to organize encounters using folder structures.
[*] Added RGB sliders to the color picker when spawning new cards! Preset colors are still available for quick generation, but the sliders can provide you more control if the color you want isn't there.
[*] Separated conditions into folders, and added the Miscellaneous folder! Separated folders will allow for conditions to be released in packs, like Class Traits, PHB Spells, Tasha's Spells, Magic Items, etc. The Miscellaneous folder contains numbers 0-9 and letters A-Z. The hope is that you will be able to use the alphabet and numbers as a stand-in until future conditions come out.
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous Quality Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed typos.
[*] Added placeholder text on health modifier input boxes.
[*] The health modifier input box is now automatically selected when opening the card painter.
[*] Pressing Enter while the card painter is open will now apply the health modifier and conditions to selected cards.
[/list]

If you have any questions, feedback or want to connect with other DM's, join the [url=https://discord.gg/ethUNRYdcd]Discord[/url]!
